# DefencePost.live

> DefencePost.live is an independent Indian defence journalism platform covering military operations, strategic policy, defence technology, naval affairs, intelligence, and geopolitics — analysed from India's strategic perspective. Updated daily.

## About
- Independent defence news and analysis for India and the world.
- Coverage: Indian Armed Forces, DRDO, indigenous weapons systems, India–Pakistan and India–China dynamics, Indo-Pacific strategy, defence exports, and global geopolitics.
